english.title: Contravene a health and safety at work prohibition notice

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Health and safety at Work Act 1974

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened a

(A)_[requirement]_
(B)_[prohibition]_

imposed by a prohibition notice served under section 22 of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974 in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 22 and 33(1)(g) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.

english.notes: Section 38 of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974 provides restrictions on the institution of proceedings in England and Wales. Proceedings for an offence under any of the relevant statutory provisions shall not, in England and Wales, be instituted except by an inspector or the Environment Agency or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

other.penalty:
Either way -
Summary: 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000.
Indictment: 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2002; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see Schedule 3A to the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Note: See section 34 for the Extension of time for brining summary proceedings.

Time limit for Prosecutions:
Complex see sections 34 and 38
